method.contrast: computed: text colour (x cumulative opacity) against the first non-transparent ancestor background; for gradients, against every colour stop of the top gradient layer (min and max reported). The pin text uses the sibling .hj-pin-face layer. pixel: the page is screenshotted with all text made transparent and the text boxes are sampled, so gradients, the translucent note and the painted scene are measured as rendered. A failure is computedMin or pixel.min below the requirement (4.5, or 3 for text >= 24 px or >= 18.66 px bold).
method.targetSize: getBoundingClientRect of button, a, input, textarea, label.hj-chip; thresholds 44x44 (phone) and 24x24 (desktop)
method.names: aria-labelledby, aria-label, label[for] / wrapping label, legend, text content; cross-checked with Playwright ariaSnapshot (the "aria" field)
method.overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth, plus every rendered element whose box crosses the viewport edge
